_contract.floor: reduced motion is the canonical design; primitives layer on top and are never required to understand a screen

tiers.1: functional, keeps a static equivalent under reduced motion
tiers.2: expressive, removed entirely under reduced motion

_contract.flatness: no opacity fade, no blur, no scale-bloom, no shadow growth
_contract.bounds: every primitive < 5s and non-looping; no flash > 3/sec (WCAG 2.2.2, 2.3.1, 2.3.3)
